gapReason.reason: The port carries one hundred and forty-one of the row's two hundred and forty defs. The ninety-nine it does not carry are the SET-MODULE DSL's own generators and registries: the set definition surface (reset, ensure_set, define_set_from_error, stage_method, define_set, the event and view method factories, the format-module registration, the inheritance and pattern lookups) and the options surface (the required_field helpers, the trait helpers, the i18n scope, the haml paths, the skip_and_trigger surface). The port carries the set-module DECLARATION surface by a different mechanism - the mod loader reads the deck's set files and the mod manifest records the registrations (src/card/mod-loader/mod-registrar.ts and src/card/mod-loader.ts, which cite lib/card/set/event.rb and lib/card/set/trait.rb) - and the port binds no generator function under Ruby's names.
